data_fields.name: attacker_cap_per_wave
data_fields.donor_constant: absent in donor (group can be 2 to 4 at tier 1, NORMAL)

best_idea: Each wave attempt samples one random tile in a fixed distance band from the nearest settlement, passes cheap ordered gates (free spot, seen ground, near land, size roll, chance roll), then spawns a group whose size steps up with the victim's size and the difficulty rate.
decision_why: The distance band, ordered gates and per-attempt sampling fit a zone wave director, but the group can reach 4 at NORMAL and must be capped at MAX_ATTACKERS = 3, and the victim's size needs a player-level stat we do not have.
acceptance: A server test places a wave 5 to 8 tiles from a player's outpost, only on ground the player has seen, and asserts one wave never has more than MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 living attackers at once, with surplus units waiting and entering when a slot frees.
